name: hackshop
description: Operating guide and hosted MCP endpoint for agents helping a human build a physical Muse body: intake, plan, choose, shop with approval, assemble, flash and pair.

allowed_actions: Read public pages and agent files.
Call POST /api/plan for deterministic Muse planning.
Open outbound product, firmware and reference links for research.
disallowed_actions: Do not buy anything without explicit approval for the exact items and total.
Do not complete checkout on eBay, manufacturer stores or any other site.
Do not activate controls tagged data-agent-danger without explicit confirmation.
Do not loop or retry rate-limited endpoints.
Do not expose real Muse SDK tokens; use mgst_YOUR_TOKEN as the placeholder in docs and code.
